description: Live calendars: works on the real calendars people connected to the app. Checks whether an account can sync. The overall status is healthy, attention or broken. If the account can't sync, the response explains why and how to fix it. A fix of reconnect means the person must sign in again, in your app: open PyasConnect with a connect session for this accountId, and the account keeps its accountId. The response also lists what the account can do (read, write, free/busy, meetings).

accountId.description: A Pyas account ID (list_accounts returns them).

name: account_status
title: Check a calendar's health
